notes.summary: TypeScript 7 (native Go port) is not supported by typescript-eslint: @typescript-eslint/parser and eslint-plugin 8.71.2 declare peer typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. vue-tsc and vite-plugin-dts also rely on the TS JS API, not verified on 7. Project kept on ~6.0.3 (all TS 6 deprecations already resolved).
notes.recheck: does @typescript-eslint/parser@latest accept typescript 7 in its peers? (npm view @typescript-eslint/parser peerDependencies) and is typescript-eslint issue #10940 closed?

history.text: Constraint set to ^6.0.3 by the maintainer. typescript-eslint 8.71.2 still accepts only <6.1.0: when TS 6.1 ships, ^6.0.3 will pick it up and npm may report a peer conflict until typescript-eslint widens its range.
